text:
emma: urgent escalation from OrionHealth on dedicated-cluster-4. customers seeing bursts of 502/503 + auth 403s. provided two failing request ids: r_f1e2d3c4 and r_f1e2d3ff. window 14:40-14:55 UTC. they asked for a repro and a support bundle (pod logs, kube events, node dmesg, nvidia-smi, and proxy traces).

kai: can you paste the tenant/namespace and route? also want the org header they used so we can match routing.

emma: tenant=orion-health (dedicated-cluster-4). namespace=orion-prod, route=text-gen-xl. customer header X-Client-Org: orion-health.

leo: i'll collect from the cluster now. checklist i'll run: 
- kubectl -n orion-prod get pods -o wide
- kubectl -n orion-prod logs deploy/text-gen-xl --since=2h > /tmp/text-gen-xl.logs
- kubectl -n orion-prod describe deploy/text-gen-xl > /tmp/deploy.desc
- kubectl -n orion-prod get events --since=2h > /tmp/kube.events
- for nodes gpu-03/gpu-04: sudo dmesg --ctime | tail -n 300 > /tmp/node.dmesg
- sudo nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY > /tmp/nvidia-memory.txt
- collect /var/log/messages and containerd logs around window
- run trace-lookup for request ids

nina: ask the customer to run this minimal curl and include the full verbose output + X-Request-ID response header if present. also request their SDK version.

nina: ```
# repro snippet - replace API_KEY and ENDPOINT
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Client-Org: orion-health" \n  -d '{"prompt":"test sequence","max_tokens":64}' \n  https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/models/text-gen-xl
```

emma: they already sent partial -v output and one more id: r_f1e2d400. masked token in their paste.

ops-bot: support-bundle tool initiated for cluster dedicated-cluster-4 by leo. job id: sb-0012.

leo: trace-lookup results:
- r_f1e2d3c4 -> trace-int-77b2 (frontend: fe-03)
- r_f1e2d3ff -> trace-int-77d8 (frontend: fe-03)
- r_f1e2d400 -> trace-int-7801 (frontend: fe-07)

leo: logs show repeated error frames starting at 14:42:11: "KernelError: kv cache exceeded allocation at step 600" logged from worker pid 482. also a sequence of `RateLimitError: kernel backpressure` around same time. saving to /tmp/text-gen-xl.logs

leo: node snapshots: gpu-04 reported GPU memory 99% and sustained MIG allocations, gpu-03 at ~72%. dmesg on gpu-04 shows Xid 79 entries and some thermal warnings but no OOM killer entries for the kernel. containerd logs show a flurry of container restarts for the model replica set at 14:43.

ops-bot: support-bundle sb-0012 completed and uploaded to s3://redwood-support/orion/orion-1767777777-support.tar.gz (presigned link valid 7d).

emma: paste the presigned link? i'll send summary and repro steps to customer. include guidance to rerun the curl with `--header 'X-Request-ID: <their id>'`.

leo: presigned: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-support/orion/orion-1767777777-support.tar.gz?X-Amz-... (masked)

nina: customer ran repro after we requested and still got a 403 for r_f1e2d3c4. they are on SDK 2.2.0. response body: 
{"status":403, "error":"key not authorized for model family"} (they masked the token).

leo: quick root cause notes: two separate issues observed - 1) auth policy update earlier today narrowed allowed models for a subset of keys which caused the 403s on fe-03; rolled back policy at 14:48 which reduced 403s. 2) the 502/503 are correlated with sudden KV-cache pressure on text-gen-xl replicas when client traffic included many long sequences; this caused kernel-level allocation failures leading to worker restarts and transient 5xxs.

nina: short-term mitigation: temporarily increase replica memory headroom for orion-health model group by 15%, and enable rate-shedding for unusually long sequence inputs. open a follow-up to infra/rls to implement a canary that sends long sequences to catch regressions.

emma: agreed. leo - can you include the lines from the trace that show frontend decision (auth deny) so we can pin to the config change?

leo: pasted snippet from frontend logs: `AuthPolicyEvaluator: key=acct-orion-22 allowlist mismatch for model_family=text-gen-xl at 2026-05-10T14:47:31Z`

emma: thanks. i'm sending the bundle link + summary and recommended next steps to the customer now. monitoring p95 latency and error rate for 1h.

ops-bot: incident created INC-3091 for follow-up (owner: infra/rls).

leo: leaving support bundle and traces pinned to INC-3091. will reopen thread if customer sees new failures.

emma: closing thread here — will update if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
